review_unsupported_claims: The proposal text reproduces the clause rather than adding anything about the tree-model rationale. The §6.2 quote is real, but the claim that it bears on the sensitivity-analysis/time-period element is a stretch, because back-testing is not the same as the period/sensitivity assessment.
review_comment: §4.3 „მგრძნობელობისა და სტაბილურობის ტესტირება ექსტრემალური მნიშვნელობების პირობებში არ ჩატარებულა“ is real, and it conflicts with the requirement to assess the effect of assumptions and sensitivity. Note that art5/p10 concerns the first line (the developer), while this is a validation report, so scope is only loosely met. The citation of §6.2 as 'partial' evidence is weak.

The regulation says „გამოყენებული უნდა იქნეს ცვლადების ექსტრემალური მნიშვნელობები“, and §4.3 states „არ ჩატარებულა“ because trees are robust. The proposal is poor: it says testing must be done 'despite' gradient boosting being robust, which restates the document's own rationale as a fact instead of fixing it.

review_unsupported_claims: The §3.2 quote is cited as 'contradicts', but it shows data-quality checks that are not in conflict with the requirement; it is irrelevant to the re-run. The proposal asserts that the validation team re-ran the model, which is a fabricated fact.
review_comment: §5.1 „მოდელის ხელახალი გაშვება ვალიდაციის ჯგუფის მიერ ... არ განხორციელებულა“ directly contradicts „მეორე ხაზმა ... უნდა გაუშვას მოდელი“. The proposal rewrites the document to claim the re-run happened, which is an invented fact rather than a remediation.

§1.1 „სტანდარტული მოცულობით, რომელიც ერთნაირად ვრცელდება ბანკის ყველა მოდელზე“ conflicts with proportionality by materiality and complexity. The proposal declares that scope was set proportionately, which fabricates compliance instead of prescribing the fix.

Art. 11 p5 („განაახლოს საზედამხედველო მოდელი მინიმუმ ყოველწლიურად და წარუდგინოს ეროვნულ ბანკს“) is a duty to the regulator concerning supervisory models, and it is not something an internal validation report would cover. The answer key shows no match, so the gap is not real and the proposed new section is inappropriate.

The duty to notify the National Bank of significant interventions in the supervisory model is a regulatory-communication process, not content of a validation report, and the document also makes no claim to be a supervisory model. The 'none' verdict flags a gap that is not a gap for this document type.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the document contains 'justification of method choice and recommendations', which is true of §4.1 and §9, but neither is about justifying a change to a supervisory model.
review_comment: The duty „დაასაბუთოს ამ ცვლილების საჭიროება“ applies to the user entity when changing a supervisory model submitted to the National Bank. A validation report of a credit-scoring model has no such obligation, and the answer key has no match.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the document does not mention alternative theories or models, but §4.1 compares gradient boosting with a reference logistic scorecard on OOT Gini (+5 pp), and §6 compares to the reference scorecard.
review_comment: §4.1 „gradient boosting-მა OOT ნიმუშზე აჩვენა Gini კოეფიციენტის 5 პროცენტული პუნქტით მაღალი მნიშვნელობა საორიენტაციო ლოგისტიკურ სკორკარდთან შედარებით“ is a comparison with an alternative approach, so the 'none' claim is false. It is also arguable that art5 p2 binds the first line (the developer), not the validation report, but the report does cover the comparison. The proposed new section is unnecessary.
